verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE claims to generate an automated post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack, which covers the drafting-from-timeline step. Nothing in the evidence shows the rest of the postmortem workflow. Missing for 10: postmortem templates, a review/approval workflow, a postmortem publication/sharing flow, in-depth docs on the postmortem feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
